choices.why: A light grey three-seat sofa 204 cm wide fits comfortably along the long left wall and matches the request exactly.
A 200x300 cm plain flatwoven beige rug is large enough to define the seating area and its neutral tone works with the grey wood floor.
A warm wood waterfall coffee table, 100x55 cm, suits the sofa's length and adds a natural wood tone, with a clean modern look.
A walnut veneer TV bench on legs, 160 cm wide, is low and modern and its wood tone echoes the coffee table.
A black arc lamp reaches over the sofa from the corner, gives warm light and picks up the black balcony frame.
Terracotta orange cushions with neutral tassels add the color the user wanted against the light grey sofa.
A tall areca palm brings fresh green and airy volume beside the balcony door without blocking light.
White sheer curtains keep the living room bright while softening the large sliding door.

answer.why: A light grey sofa, beige rug and white sheers keep the room bright and modern, while warm wood on the coffee table and TV bench ties in with the floor. The terracotta cushions, green palm and black arc lamp add color and contrast, echoing the black door frame.
